title: Apple Refreshes the Mac Mini and Mac Studio, Both With New AI-Ready Chips
summary: Apple Refreshes the Mac Mini and Mac Studio, Both With New AI-Ready Chips WIRED
body: Apple Refreshes the Mac Mini and Mac Studio, Both With New AI-Ready Chips WIRED
summaryZh: 苹果公司对Mac Mini和Mac Studio产品线进行了更新，均搭载了支持端侧AI运算的新型芯片。原始信息显示：Apple Refreshes the Mac Mini and Mac Studio, Both With New AI-Ready Chips WIRED。该消息由WIRED发布，主题为“Apple Refreshes the Mac Mini and Mac Studio, Both With New AI-Ready Chips”。其重要性主要体现在：苹果发布了集成全新AI就绪芯片的Mac Mini和Mac Studio，属于重要的硬件平台更新。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
